# oneuptime_network_device_discovery_scan_data (Data Source)

Network device discovery scan data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_network_device_discovery_scan_data" "example" {
  name = "example-network_device_discovery_scan_data"
}
```
